text.tspan: THE NAMING ECHO IS IN THE RECORD. IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH CONTACT. SORT-LAST NAMING
WAS ALREADY A HABIT HERE — AND IT DID NOT WORK. A SIMILAR NAME CAN SOLVE A SIMILAR
SORTING PROBLEM WITHOUT ONE POPULATION TEACHING THE OTHER. THE ECHO IS WORTH
INVESTIGATING; IT IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR A TRACE OF CONTACT.
